sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Do not freeze yet. Preserve the repaired branch structure, owner paths, quantity datatypes/units, and expected-result-scaled tolerances. Require the qualified hasComponent nodes to be typed nltl:inletChest (for example, add sh:class nltl:inletChest to the common chest node shape or to both qualified value shapes); currently the standard and alternative branches can count arbitrary shipComponent nodes that merely satisfy the property constraints, so the declared typed-inletChest applicability and relationship requirement is not enforced.
